Opacity can be updated at scale in the variables modal and applied on top of any color without detaching.
→ Alias opacity
while the color stays linked to your library, instead of needing to detach and adjust opacity by hand.
→ Set opacity on a color variable using a number variable,
and scope them specifically for use in color variables.
→ Easily update opacity
across disabled states, overlays, scrims, and more.
Learn more in the help center

At Config, we launched the ability build your own custom generative plugins and shaders by prompting the Figma agent. Now, you can do more with those generative plugins and shaders with animations and interactions, publishing capabilities, and access to the code.
Animated and interactive shaders
: Prompt the agent to build a custom shader effect or fill that incorporates motion and is reactive to mouse movements.
Learn more.
Community publishing
: Share your generative plugins and shaders with the world by publishing them for others to use on the Figma Community. Learn more about
Community publishing for shaders
and
Community publishing for generative plugins.
Publish to organization
: Share private generative plugins and shaders with your organization to standardize effects or tool usage. Only available on Organization and Enterprise plans.
Learn more.
Code viewer
: View and download the code for any shader and your own generative plugins, right in Figma.
Learn more.
MCP updates
: View and make changes to your generative plugins and shaders with a third party agent via Figma’s MCP server. Plus, when you copy a Figma frame with shaders applied to an external agent, on implementation the shaders will render correctly in the generated React code.
Learn more
Read the blog post

You can now open the agent chat panel into a new window on the Figma desktop app for both macOS and Windows. It stays visible when you work with other tools or switch tabs.
Here's what's new:
→ Open the agent chat panel into its own window
→ Move it anywhere on your screen
→ Always keep it visible while you design
Download the desktop app here.

Vector editing in Figma now brings familiar interactions to precise edits on the canvas. Erasing and recoloring feel more direct, so you can shape vector work by hand without breaking your flow.
Erase vector paths directly to clean up stray marks or reshape existing artwork
Choose a color or gradient, then drag to fill or recolor multiple regions at once
Press Shift+E to switch to the eraser in vector edit mode or Draw mode. The existing Shift+E shortcut for the Prototype tab in Design mode stays the same.
Learn more about the
eraser and paint bucket tools

Admins on Enterprise and Organization plans can centrally manage Figma MCP server's connection to AI agents (e.g. Claude) through their identity provider (e.g. Okta), so users don't have to authenticate individually or click through repeated consent prompts.
Support for additional identity providers and AI agents is planned for the future.
Learn more about setting up enterprise-managed authorization

New release

Copy link
Auto layout's auto spacing now has two new options, “Around” and “Evenly”, alongside the existing default auto spacing behavior now called “Between”.
These match spacing patterns CSS already supports including:
→ Between:
even gaps between items, nothing at the edges. Same existing default functionality, renamed to match CSS terminology.
→ Around:
even gaps between items, with half that gap at each edge.
→ Evenly:
every gap is identical, including the edges.
Learn more in the help center

Admins can now choose which resources (skills, templates, libraries, and Make kits) are recommended to your organization or workspace, so your users work with the right tools from the start.
Recommended resources display a checkmark and a tooltip noting "Recommended by [organization or workspace admin]," helping users identify the right resources without guessing.
Learn more about managing and recommending resources

Text wrap makes your text responsive with two new options: Balance and Pretty. Set either on a text layer, a text style, or an individual paragraph in text settings.
→ Balance
: distributes text evenly across lines.
→ Pretty:
avoids a single word stranded alone on the last line.
